questions.question:
What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘÷‘ are interchanged and ‘−’ and ‘×’ are interchanged?

18 ÷ 15 + 5 × 3 − 4 = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/c0j5U9v2oJWEzSTKvdDLWZ5Zik3PBUXk-C9w3Ma990WH63rpQUfA7g-3wh_uT7CgFvFJ4jPGEeOw509FxSgfh78_HR9tDNZ9KitXdEveKsLaLMgPQf6YSDt1b775728JMVp9FIQs=s0] 

**Given equation:**

18 ÷ 15 + 5 × 3 − 4 = ?

**Given Sign Interchanges:**

__
 
• ‘+’ and ‘÷‘ are interchanged
 
• ‘−’ and ‘×’ are interchanged

Applying the sign interchanges to the given equation:

Original: 18 ÷ 15 + 5 × 3 − 4

New equation: 18 + 15 ÷ 5 − 3 × 4

= 18 + **15 ÷ 5__** − __**3 × 4**__

= __**18 + 3**__ − 12

= **__21 − 12__**

= 9

Therefore, the value of the question mark (?) is 9.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

 Statements:

All drawers are racks.

Some racks are cabinets.

All cabinets are shelves.

 Conclusions:

(I) All shelves are racks.

(II) Some shelves are drawers.
questions.solution:
**Statements:**

All drawers are racks.

Some racks are cabinets.

All cabinets are shelves.

The least possible venn diagram is given:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb1238bf815827ceaa086d022fde3c6a44fa0c93e6fba5424dd0f98bb4bdbf91.png] 

 **Conclusions:**

(I) All shelves are racks - **False**(because, all cabinets are shelves are given, it implies that some shelves are cabinets, so it can possible only).

(II) Some shelves are drawers - False(because, there is no direct relation is given, so it can be possible only).

Thus, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
